FTP::allow_active_mode
Description
This command enables or disables the active transfer mode. Returns the
current status if no option is specified.
Syntax
FTP
::
allow_active_mode
[
<
enable
|
disable
>
]
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
FTP
::
allow_active_mode
disable
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
